# Seller Margin Calculator (2026) — Knowledge Base & Fee Engine Reference
> Authoritative financial calculation engine and fee intelligence for global e-commerce and eBay sellers.
> Official Web Application: https://asfandateem-sketch.github.io/Ebay-Calculator/

## Executive Overview
Seller Margin Calculator provides real-time, fee-accurate calculation models for eBay and global e-commerce sellers across 8 major marketplaces (United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, Germany, France, Italy, Spain). All calculations reflect active 2026 Managed Payments rules, tiered category percentages, fixed per-order fees, sales tax/VAT inclusion thresholds, and advertising dynamics.

## Mathematical Formulas

### 1. Final Value Fee (FVF) Calculation
eBay calculates Final Value Fees on the **Total Amount of the Sale**, which legally includes the item sale price, shipping charged to the buyer, and any applicable state sales tax or marketplace VAT collected by eBay:
```
Total Sale Base = Sold Price + Shipping Charged to Buyer + Sales Tax/VAT Amount
Category FVF = Total Sale Base × Category FVF Rate %
Total eBay Fee = Category FVF + Fixed Order Processing Fee + Promoted Ad Fee + International Fee + Insertion Fee
```

### 2. Fixed Order Processing Fee Rules (US & Global)
- **United States (US)**: $0.30 per order if total sale is greater than $10.00; $0.40 per order if total sale is $10.00 or under.
- **United Kingdom (UK)**: £0.30 per order for commercial/business accounts. (0% selling fee applies to domestic private sellers).
- **Germany (DE)**: €0.35 per order for business sellers. (0% selling fee applies to domestic private sellers).
- **Canada (CA)**: C$0.30 per order.
- **Australia (AU)**: A$0.30 per order.
- **France (FR) / Italy (IT) / Spain (ES)**: €0.35 per order for business sellers.

### 3. Net Profit Formula
```
Total Revenue = (Sold Price + Shipping Charged) × Quantity
Total Direct Costs = (Item Unit Cost + Actual Shipping Cost + Other Direct Costs) × Quantity
Net Profit = Total Revenue - Total Direct Costs - Total eBay Fees
Profit Margin % = (Net Profit / Total Revenue) × 100
Return on Investment (ROI) % = (Net Profit / Total Direct Costs) × 100
```

### 4. Closed-Form Break-Even Price Formula
The exact selling price required to yield exactly $0.00 net profit, accounting for category percentage on item and shipping, tax leakage, and fixed transaction charges:
```
BreakEvenPrice = (Total Unit Costs + Fixed Fee + (FVF Rate × (Buyer Shipping + Sales Tax))) / (1 - FVF Rate - Promoted Ad Rate - International Fee Rate)
```

### 5. Target Margin Pricing Formula
To achieve a guaranteed target net profit margin (e.g., 20% or 30% net margin):
```
TargetPrice = (Total Unit Costs + Fixed Fee + (FVF Rate × (Buyer Shipping + Sales Tax))) / (1 - FVF Rate - Promoted Ad Rate - International Fee Rate - Target Margin %)
```

### 6. E-commerce Landed Cost & Break-Even Velocity
```
Landed Cost Per Unit = (Batch Purchase Outlay + Inbound Freight + Customs Duties + Handling) / Total Units Purchased
Unit Contribution Margin = Selling Price - Landed Cost Per Unit - Platform Channel Commission - Shipping Outbound Cost - Target Ad Spend Per Unit
Monthly Operating Break-Even Units = Total Monthly Fixed Overhead / Unit Contribution Margin
Capital Payback Units = Total Initial Landed Outlay / Unit Contribution Margin
```

## Marketplace Fee Schedules (Standard 2026 Rates)

| Marketplace | Standard Category Rate | Fixed Fee (> $10 / ≤ $10) | Private Seller Exemption | Currency |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| United States (US) | 13.25% (up to $7,500) | $0.30 / $0.40 | No | USD ($) |
| United Kingdom (UK) | 12.80% (Business) | £0.30 | Yes (0% fees for private sellers) | GBP (£) |
| Germany (DE) | 12.00% (Business) | €0.35 | Yes (0% fees for private sellers) | EUR (€) |
| Australia (AU) | 13.40% (Business) | A$0.30 | Partial promotions | AUD (A$) |
| Canada (CA) | 13.25% | C$0.30 | No | CAD (C$) |
| France (FR) | 12.00% (Business) | €0.35 | Partial | EUR (€) |
| Italy (IT) | 12.00% (Business) | €0.35 | Partial | EUR (€) |
| Spain (ES) | 12.00% (Business) | €0.35 | Partial | EUR (€) |
